lane: مُرْتَجٌ A door, and a chamber, or house, locked, or shut or closed, (مُغْلَقٌ,) so as to be made fast, or firm. (A.) مُرْتِجٌ , applied to a she-camel, ‡ Pregnant; because the mouth of her womb becomes closed against the seed of the stallion: (T, A, * TA:) applied also to a she-ass, in the same sense: (TA:) pl. مَرَاتِجُ and مَرَاتِيجُ. (A, TA.)

entries.text: المرتج: المردارسنج، وليس بتصحيف: مريخ، والوجه ضم ميمه، لأنه معرب: مرده.
